post_hoc_detail: High-decay nets (grid 4, alpha8<=0.2, n=24): median eps_chain 0.0135; INIT eps at k=0 median 0.684 (min 0.50), at k=16 0.0031, k=64 0.0009; k_fid(INIT)=16 for all 24. Dependent nets (n=58 with chain): k_fid(INIT)=1024 in 76% (<=512 in 24%); weights-only I1 and I2 reach eps<=eps_chain before keeping everything in only 7% of nets. Median eps at k=512: INIT 0.013, I1 0.128, I2 0.295. Caveats: eps is measured on N(0,I) inputs (ARC's distribution), not the task distribution; INIT always keeps Delta in full and varies only the remnant slice; one fresh draw per net (draw-to-draw log-ratio spread 0.016); first stats stage crashed on a width-512 key and was rerun from the saved results (--stats-only); 6 of 64 dependent nets lack a finite chain prediction. P3 passes trivially (all medians are 1024).
